items.title: Bob Magnusson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I haven’t called Kenny about it, but I talked to Joey a little bit about it, and he’s interested.

ctx.x: MB: No, Kenny Barron is the piano player, and I want to use Kenny too. I want to use Kenny. I haven’t called Kenny about it, but I talked to Joey a little bit about it, and he’s interested. And Peter Sprague, this guitar player I think and do a quartet thing. So that looks like it might happen. Hal Leonard is publishing a bass book that I’ve put together. I just got the drafts back from them a couple of weeks ago so I’m looking that over. So that will be coming out — it’s a “How To Build Walking Bass Lines” kind…
Well I was supposed to ask you a question about your bass. There’s something different about the neck or something? MB: I don’t know other than it’s a very long length.
